pattern: Status message (WCAG 4.1.3): role=status for polite updates, role=alert for urgent ones, plain text when static.

aria.value: status or alert when live is enabled; absent otherwise

keyboard.action: Not focusable; read in document order by assistive technology.

notes: Tone is conveyed by an icon and a visually hidden, localized prefix such as 'Error:', never by color alone.
Live roles announce only changes made after the region exists; create it with live set, then call update().
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
